chain.label: Maintenance manual lacks trunnion-pin verification step
chain.trigger: Learjet maintenance manual procedures for installing the main landing gear do not contain a step to ensure that the aft trunnion pin is positioned correctly or that the retaining bolt is secured through it

chain.label: Hard landing bursts left main gear tires (McAlester, June 2024)
chain.trigger: the airplane landed hard just short of the runway surface and bounced several times. As a result of the hard landing, both left main landing gear tires burst

chain.label: Mechanic reinstalls aft trunnion pin without fully seating it
chain.trigger: the aft trunnion pin was not correctly installed... The retaining bolt had been installed and secured in the aft trunnion casting without going through the hole in the aft trunnion pin

caused_by.evidence: The captain hired a mechanic... to perform a hard landing inspection... which included removing both main landing gear to facilitate the required inspections
In the absence of a required verification step, a mechanic could inadvertently install the retaining bolt without it passing through the trunnion pin

chain.label: Left main gear insecurely attached, undetected for months
chain.trigger: the insecure attachment resulting from such misassembly is not readily detectable during routine maintenance or preflight inspections

caused_by.evidence: The absence of the aft trunnion pin... from the trunnion casting indicated that the retaining bolt was secured to the aft trunnion casting without passing through the aft trunnion pin

chain.label: Left main landing gear displaces and separates during SDL landing
chain.trigger: a witness-supplied video showing the airplane on final approach with the left landing gear trailing aft from its normal position... The left main landing gear separated from the airplane and came to rest... adjacent to taxiway B

caused_by.evidence: installation of the aft trunnion pin without engaging its retaining bolt can result in the landing gear separating from the airplane during landing

chain.label: Airplane enters left-wing-low attitude and veers left on touchdown
chain.trigger: The airplane immediately entered a left-wing-low attitude and began veering left, exiting the runway surface

caused_by.evidence: immediately entered a left-wing-low attitude and began veering left

chain.label: Airplane departs left side of runway 21
chain.trigger: it departed the left side of the runway 21... The airplane traveled over the rock-covered runway safety areas located between the runway and taxiways

caused_by.evidence: began veering left, exiting the runway surface

chain.label: Airplane strikes windsock and parked Gulfstream G200
chain.trigger: The airplane crossed taxiway B, collided with a windsock, and entered the ramp area where it struck the right side of the parked Gulfstream G200

caused_by.evidence: traveled over the rock-covered runway safety areas... crossed taxiway B, collided with a windsock

chain.label: Captain fatally injured; others seriously and minorly injured
chain.trigger: The Learjet's captain was fatally injured, the first officer (FO) and one passenger were seriously injured, and one passenger received minor injuries; additionally, an occupant inside the parked airplane... sustained serious injuries

caused_by.evidence: struck the right side of the parked Gulfstream G200
